1. Import Salmon quantification using Tximport
```{r}
# Load metadata and tx2gene file
dir <- "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/RNA_seq/BPPNM_PPNM_invivo_RNAseq"
meta <- read.table(file.path(dir,"Analysis/BPPNM_PPNM_meta.csv"), sep=",",header=T)
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition)
meta$EMT <- factor(meta$EMT)
txdb <- makeTxDbFromEnsembl(organism="Mus musculus", release=108)
k <- keys(txdb, keytype="TXNAME")
tx2gene <- select(txdb, k, "GENEID", "TXNAME")
# Load Salmon output using tximport
files <- file.path(dir,paste("salmon/",meta$Sample,"_salmon", sep=""),"quant.sf")
txi_data <- tximport(files, type="salmon",tx2gene=tx2gene, ignoreTxVersion = T)
```
2. Run DEseq
2.1 Make DEseq object
```{r}
names(txi_data)
head(txi_data$counts)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi_data, colData = meta, design = ~Condition)
colnames(dds) <- meta$Name
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep,]
dds
```
2.2 Run DEseq
```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
res.BPPNM_EMT <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","BPPNM_Mes","BPPNM_Epi"), alpha=0.05, lfcThreshold = 1)
res.PPNM_EMT <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","PPNM_Mes","PPNM_Epi"), alpha=0.05, lfcThreshold = 1)
res.Genotype_Epi <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","BPPNM_Epi","PPNM_Epi"), alpha=0.05, lfcThreshold = 1)
res.Genotype_Mes <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","BPPNM_Mes","PPNM_Mes"), alpha=0.05, lfcThreshold = 1)
summary(res.BPPNM_EMT)
summary(res.PPNM_EMT)
summary(res.Genotype_Epi)
summary(res.Genotype_Mes)
```
```{r}
saveRDS(dds, file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_PPNM_invivo_deseq2.rds"))
```

2.4 Make Volcano Plots and save data
```{r}
genenames <- select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
resfiles <- list(res.BPPNM_EMT,res.PPNM_EMT,res.Genotype_Epi,res.Genotype_Mes)
filenames <- c("BPPNM_Mes_vs_BPPNM_Epi.deseq2_output.tsv", "PPNM_Mes_vs_PPNM_Epi.deseq2_output.tsv",
               "BPPNM_Epi_vs_PPNM_Epi.deseq2_output.tsv", "BPPNM_Mes_vs_PPNM_Mes.deseq2_output.tsv")
plotnames <- c("BPPNM_Mes_vs_BPPNM_Epi", "PPNM_Mes_vs_PPNM_Epi",
               "BPPNM_Epi_vs_PPNM_Epi", "BPPNM_Mes_vs_PPNM_Mes")
p <- list()
for (i in 1:4){
  resp_table <- merge(as.data.frame(resfiles[i]), genenames, by.x=0, by.y="ENSEMBL")
  resp_table <- resp_table[!duplicated(resp_table$SYMBOL),]
  resp_table <- resp_table %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
  resp_table <- resp_table[order(resp_table$padj), ]
  p[[i]] <- EnhancedVolcano(resp_table, lab=rownames(resp_table), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj", title= plotnames[i], xlim = c(-8,8), pointSize = 1, pCutoff=10e-5, FCcutoff=1, labSize=4)
  print(p[[i]])
  write.table(resp_table, file=file.path(dir, "DEseq2",filenames[i]), sep='\t', row.names=T)
  resSig <- subset(resp_table, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
  resSig <- resSig[order(resSig$log2FoldChange),]
  print(str(sum(resSig$log2FoldChange < 0)), str(sum(resSig$log2FoldChange > 0)))
  write.table(resSig, file=paste(dir, "/DEseq2/",plotnames[i],".deseq2_significant.tsv",sep=""), sep='\t', row.names=T)
}
```

5. GSEA pathway specific DGE heatmap
```{r}
dir <- "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/BPPNM_PPNM_invivo_RNAseq"

dirg <- "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/BPPNM_PPNM_invivo_RNAseq/GSEA/BPPNM_Mes_vs_BPPNM_Epi.Gsea.1683065828709"
mes <- read.csv(file.path(dirg,"gsea_report_for_BPPNM_Mes_1683065828709.tsv"), sep="\t")
epi <- read.csv(file.path(dirg,"gsea_report_for_BPPNM_Epi_1683065828709.tsv"), sep="\t")
get_genes <- function(mes, epi, dir){
  genes <- c()
  for (p in mes$NAME[1:3]){
    print(p)
    p_file <- read.csv(paste(dir, "/",p,".tsv", sep=""), sep="\t")
    ngenes <- p_file$SYMBOL[1:10]
    genes <- c(genes,ngenes)
  }
  for (p in epi$NAME[c(1:3)]){
    print(p)
    p_file <- read.csv(paste(dir, "/",p,".tsv", sep=""), sep="\t")
    nrows <- dim(p_file)[1]
    ngenes <- p_file$SYMBOL[(nrows-9):nrows]
    genes <- c(genes,ngenes)
    }
  return(genes)
}
genes <- get_genes(mes,epi, dirg)
# Normalize genes and plot heatmap
# Convert row.names to human symbol
mensembl_hgnc_zscores <- function(counts){
  gns <- rownames(counts)
  genenames <- select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys= keys(org.Mm.eg.db, keytype="ENSEMBL"), columns=c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL"), keytype="ENSEMBL")
  genenames <- genenames[!duplicated(genenames$SYMBOL),]
  norm_genes <- merge(genenames, counts, by.x="ENSEMBL", by.y=0)
  norm_genes <- norm_genes %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "SYMBOL")
  norm_genes <- norm_genes[-c(1)]
  means <- rowMeans(norm_genes)
  sds <- apply(norm_genes, 1, sd)
  heatmap_zscore <- (norm_genes-means)/sds # Z-score normalized gene expression
  return(heatmap_zscore)
}
dds <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_PPNM_invivo_deseq2.rds"))
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
count <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd))
norm_genes <- mensembl_hgnc_zscores(count)
gsea_top10 <- norm_genes[match(genes, rownames(norm_genes)),] %>% drop_na()
#gsea_top10 <- norm_genes[rownames(norm_genes) %in% genes,]
pheatmap(gsea_top10, cluster_rows = F, gaps_row=c(10,20,30,40,50),color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50))
```

```{r}
hypoxia_genes <- intersect(hypoxia$gene_symbol,union(rownames(BPPNM_EMT),rownames(PPNM_EMT)))
```


```{r}
calc_averagez <- function(norm_genes){
  BPPNM_Epi <- rowMeans(norm_genes[,c(1,3,5,7,9)])
  BPPNM_Mes <- rowMeans(norm_genes[,c(2,4,6,8,10)])
  PPNM_Epi <- rowMeans(norm_genes[,c(11,13,15,17,19)])
  PPNM_Mes <- rowMeans(norm_genes[,c(12,14,16,18,20)])
  average_zscore <- as.data.frame(cbind(BPPNM_Epi, PPNM_Epi, BPPNM_Mes, PPNM_Mes))
  return(average_zscore)
}
```

```{r}
# Make heatmap
avg_expression <- calc_averagez(norm_genes)
select_genes <- avg_expression[match(hypoxia_genes, rownames(avg_expression)),] %>% drop_na()
pheatmap(select_genes, color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50))
```

6. KEGG analysis 
```{r}
mouse_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus")
mouse_kegg = mouse_gene_sets %>% dplyr::filter(gs_subcat == "CP:KEGG")
kegg_pathways <- c("KEGG_GLYCOSAMINOGLYCAN_BIOSYNTHESIS_CHONDROITIN_SULFATE",
                   "KEGG_GLYCOSPHINGOLIPID_BIOSYNTHESIS_GANGLIO_SERIES",
                   "KEGG_DORSO_VENTRAL_AXIS_FORMATION",
                   "KEGG_LEUKOCYTE_TRANSENDOTHELIAL_MIGRATION",
                   "KEGG_ECM_RECEPTOR_INTERACTION")
kegg_genes <- mouse_kegg[mouse_kegg$gs_name %in% kegg_pathways,]
write.table(kegg_genes, file=file.path(dir,"Analysis/kegg_genes.txt"),sep="\t")

dds <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_PPNM_invivo_deseq2.rds"))
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
count <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd))
norm_genes <- mensembl_hgnc_zscores(count)
avg_expression <- calc_averagez(norm_genes)
plist = list()
for (i in seq(5)){
  gs <- kegg_pathways[i]
  kegg_df <- kegg_genes[kegg_genes$gs_name==gs,]
  bppnm_kegg <- intersect(kegg_df$gene_symbol, 
                          union(rownames(BPPNM_EMT), rownames(PPNM_EMT)))
  select_genes <- avg_expression[match(bppnm_kegg, rownames(avg_expression)),] %>% drop_na()
  p <- pheatmap(select_genes, color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50))
  plist[[i]] <- p
}
grid.arrange(plist[[1]],plist[[2]], plist[[3]], plist[[4]],plist[[5]], nrow=2)

```

```{r}
write.xlsx(deseq_immunesets,file.path(dir,"Analysis/DE_subsets_immune.xlsx"),rowNames=T)

# Gene sets
ligands <- union(rownames(ligand_Bimmune), rownames(ligand_Pimmune))
receptor <- union(rownames(receptor_Bimmune), rownames(receptor_Pimmune))
epigenetic <- union(rownames(epi_Bimmune), rownames(epi_Pimmune))
# Make heatmaps
select_genes <- avg_expression[match(epigenetic, rownames(avg_expression)),] %>% drop_na()
pheatmap(select_genes, cluster_cols=F, color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50))
```

```{r}
# human to mouse
fun <- function(gns){
    egs <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, gns, "ENTREZID","ENSEMBL")
    mapped <- select(Orthology.eg.db, egs, "Homo.sapiens","Mus.musculus")
    mapped$HS <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, as.character(mapped$Homo.sapiens), "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
    mapped <- mapped[!is.na(mapped$Homo.sapiens) & !duplicated(mapped$HS),]
    return(mapped)
}
gene_df <- fun(PPNM_immune$Row.names)
PPNM_genes <- merge(PPNM_immune,gene_df["HS"], by.x="Row.names" ,by.y=0)
# Do column to rownames and remove ENSEMBL column
colnames(hgsc_nfte) <- c("human.t.statist","human.L2FC","human.p.value")
PPNM_genes$HS <- unlist(PPNM_genes$HS)
PPNM_genes <- merge(PPNM_genes,hgsc_nfte, by.x="HS",by.y=0, all=F)
PPNM_genes <- PPNM_genes %>%  remove_rownames() %>% column_to_rownames("Var.2")
PPNM_genes <- PPNM_genes[order(-PPNM_genes$human.t.statist),]
```
